name: nonApi_mayModerateChat
description: May this user delete ANYONE's message in this thread? (E9.F1.S14.) The one place the rule lives: the chat message readers call it once per fetch to fill canDelete, and nonApi_deleteChatMessage calls it before removing a message. Run chat (@eventId set) ⇒ the moderateChat permission function in the RUN'S kennel; kennel chat (@kennelId set, @eventId NULL) ⇒ moderateChat in that kennel; room or DM (both NULL) ⇒ platform admins only (HC.PlatformAdmin, removed = 0), because rooms span kennels and a DM belongs to no kennel. A platform admin passes everything without a kennel check. moderateChat is an HC.PermissionFunction row (defaults: GM, Web Meister, the Manage chat flag 0x200) resolved through HC6.CheckKennelPermission, so a kennel can widen or narrow it like any other function. Internal (EXEC from other SPs); no auth of its own. Returns nothing; the answer is the @allowed OUTPUT (1/0, never NULL). Until 2026-09-30 the platform check read AppAccessFlags 0x40000000 on any kennel row — the kennel Super Admin flag held by 294 hashers.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The internal id of the hasher asking. NULL ⇒ @allowed = 0.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run whose chat it is. When set, @kennelId is overwritten with the run's kennel. Default NULL.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel whose chat it is; ignored when @eventId is set. Default NULL. Both NULL ⇒ a room or a DM.

parameters.name: allowed
parameters.description: OUTPUT: 1 when the user may moderate the thread, otherwise 0. Always set (COALESCEd to 0).

sideEffects: Reads HC.PlatformAdmin, HC.Event; EXECs HC6.CheckKennelPermission (functionKey 'moderateChat'). Writes nothing.

codeSmells.detail: @userId has no SQL default. Called only by EXEC from other HC6 SPs (chat readers, nonApi_deleteChatMessage), which always pass it. A call that omits one fails before the body runs — no HC.ErrorLog row, no graceful check (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default').

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: No TRY/CATCH anywhere in the body (lines 32–57). It is a pure read helper that runs inside the calling SP's TRY, so a runtime error here surfaces through the caller's CATCH; it would not be attributed to this proc in HC.ErrorLog.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
